notes.adjudicator: non-blind manual review against official gold messages and fixed head
notes.scope: PR-scope true positives only; positional matches are reported separately

candidates.title: ORDER BY al.id DESC added to shared query may change pagination stability semantics
candidates.reason: Gold 0 is about the helper dropping the caller context (context.Background) and pool exhaustion; this candidate is about UUID tie-breakers in ORDER BY. Different defect and unrelated causal chain.

candidates.title: has_more computed from len(entries) may be wrong if scan drops rows
candidates.reason: Gold 1 is the non-transactional Count/Query race, gold 2 is nil-on-error returning 200, gold 20/24 are the limit+1 and missing test coverage. This candidate claims dropped scan rows make has_more false, but dropping rows makes len smaller so has_more becomes more likely true; the stated failure mode is inverted. Not gold.

candidates.title: Detail fetch errors stored but may not be surfaced to the user
candidates.reason: Gold 3's trigger is the entry.id guard running after setExpandedId, so no fetch and no loading/error UI. This candidate notices error surfacing but never identifies the missing-id early return, so it is not a strict match.
